content.text:
A published book with no copies left now shows `isAvailable: false`. `dotnet build` and `dotnet test` pass on `Library.slnx`, with 7 of 7 tests passing.

The cause was an off-by-one in the hand-written `CalculateIsAvailable()` in `src/Library/Domain/Book.cs`. It checked `Copies >= 0`, which is true even at zero copies, so I changed it to `Copies > 0`.

I added a regression test, `BookIsAvailableOnlyWhenPublishedWithAtLeastOneCopy`, in `src/Library.Tests/LibraryApiTests.cs`. It creates three books through the API and checks each one's availability:

| Status | Copies | `isAvailable` |
|---|---|---|
| Published | 0 | false |
| Published | 1 | true |
| Draft | 3 | false |

I haven't run the new test against the old `>= 0` code, so I haven't seen it fail there.
